1: # Tasks — add-native-data-exchange (Phase 4 #7 slice — native STEP export)
2: 
3: Order: ISO-10303-21 text formatting → Part-42 entity emitters + `#n` id/dedup → topology
4: walk + representability gate → header/units/context wrapper → native writer API →
5: engine native-else-fallback wiring + OCCT-read round-trip self-check → Gate 1 (host
6: structural) → Gate 2 (sim native-write / OCCT-read round-trip) → docs. Native code stays
7: OCCT-free + host-buildable (`/opt/homebrew/opt/llvm/bin/clang++ -std=c++20`). No `cc_*`
8: ABI change. Default engine stays OCCT. STEP import + IGES export/import stay OCCT.
9: 
10: IMPLEMENTATION NOTE: the module is factored as `step_writer.h/.cpp` (text formatting +
11: Part-42 emitters + topology walk, all in one TU) + the `native_exchange.h` umbrella,
12: rather than the separate `step_text.h` / `step_entities.h` files the original plan
13: sketched — the same responsibilities, one cohesive OCCT-free translation unit. All
14: writer functions came out 🟢 Excellent (≤ 7 cognitive complexity), so the systems-band
15: walk the plan anticipated did not materialise (the walk is split into small
16: vertex/curve/edge/loop/surface/face methods).
17: 
18: ## 1. ISO-10303-21 text formatting (`step_writer.cpp`, OCCT-free)
19: 
20: - [x] 1.1 Real-number formatting to ISO-10303-21 lexical rules (a decimal point always
21:       present, full fp64 precision via `%.17g`, no locale dependence); string, enum
22:       (`.T.` / `.F.` / `.UNSPECIFIED.`), and list `( ... )` formatting.
23: - [x] 1.2 An entity-record writer (`DataWriter::emit`): `#n = KEYWORD(args);` with a
24:       monotonic `#n` allocator.
25: - [x] 1.3 Host-buildable, includes only STL + `src/native/{topology,math}`; cognitive
26:       complexity 🟢.
27: 
28: ## 2. Part-42 entity emitters + id dedup (`step_writer.cpp`, OCCT-free)
29: 
30: - [x] 2.1 Leaf emitters with value-dedup: `CARTESIAN_POINT`, `DIRECTION`,
31:       `AXIS2_PLACEMENT_3D` (from `math::Ax3`), `VERTEX_POINT`.
32: - [x] 2.2 Curve emitters: `LINE` (+`VECTOR`), `CIRCLE`, `B_SPLINE_CURVE_WITH_KNOTS`
33:       (degree, poles, knots+multiplicities via RLE-compress of the flat knot vector).
34:       Rational (weighted) spline is out of scope → DECLINE (canSerialize false).
35: - [x] 2.3 Surface emitters: `PLANE`, `CYLINDRICAL_SURFACE`, `CONICAL_SURFACE`,
36:       `SPHERICAL_SURFACE`, `B_SPLINE_SURFACE_WITH_KNOTS`. Rational surface out of scope.
37: - [x] 2.4 Topology emitters: `EDGE_CURVE`, `ORIENTED_EDGE`, `EDGE_LOOP`,
38:       `FACE_OUTER_BOUND` / `FACE_BOUND`, `ADVANCED_FACE`, `CLOSED_SHELL`,
39:       `MANIFOLD_SOLID_BREP`.
40: - [x] 2.5 A dedup map so shared leaves emit ONE record: `CARTESIAN_POINT` / `DIRECTION`
41:       value-deduped; `VERTEX_POINT` deduped by its `CARTESIAN_POINT` id; `EDGE_CURVE`
42:       deduped GEOMETRICALLY (unordered endpoint-vertex pair + curve signature) so the two
43:       adjacent faces of a physical edge — which carry DISTINCT edge nodes because the
44:       native builders defer edge-node sharing (#4) — share ONE `EDGE_CURVE`, welding a
45:       manifold `CLOSED_SHELL`. Each emitter ≤ 7 cognitive complexity.
46: 
47: ## 3. Topology walk + representability gate (`step_writer.h`, OCCT-free)
48: 
49: - [x] 3.1 Representability gate (`canSerialize`): accept ONLY a native `Solid`/`Shell`
50:       (or Compound/CompSolid) whose faces are `Plane`/`Cylinder`/`Cone`/`Sphere`/`BSpline`
51:       and whose edges are `Line`/`Circle`/`BSpline` (knotted, non-rational); else DECLINE.
52: - [x] 3.2 Bottom-up walk (points/directions → placements → curves/surfaces →
53:       vertices/edges → loops/bounds → faces → shell → solid), assigning `#n` ids so every
54:       reference is defined before use (no dangling forward reference — asserted by the
55:       host test's contiguous-ascending-id check).
56: - [x] 3.3 Map native `Orientation` → `ORIENTED_EDGE` / `ADVANCED_FACE` sense flags;
57:       native face outer wire (child 0) → `FACE_OUTER_BOUND`, holes → `FACE_BOUND`.
58: - [x] 3.4 Read geometry via `src/native/topology` accessors (`curveOf` / `surfaceOf` /
59:       `pointOf`), coordinates in true mm, world-placed via each shape's `Location`. The
60:       walk stayed 🟢 (split into small methods), not the anticipated systems-band function.
61: 
62: ## 4. Header + units + AP203 context wrapper (`step_writer.cpp`)
63: 
64: - [x] 4.1 Emit the ISO-10303-21 `HEADER` (`FILE_DESCRIPTION`, `FILE_NAME`, `FILE_SCHEMA`
65:       naming the AP203 `CONFIG_CONTROL_DESIGN` schema).
66: - [x] 4.2 Emit the mm unit context: `SI_UNIT(.MILLI.,.METRE.)` length + radian plane-angle
67:       + steradian solid-angle, `UNCERTAINTY_MEASURE_WITH_UNIT`, and the combined
68:       `GEOMETRIC_REPRESENTATION_CONTEXT` / `GLOBAL_UNIT_ASSIGNED_CONTEXT`.
69: - [x] 4.3 Emit the AP203 product spine (`APPLICATION_CONTEXT`,
70:       `APPLICATION_PROTOCOL_DEFINITION`, `PRODUCT`, `PRODUCT_DEFINITION_FORMATION_WITH_
71:       SPECIFIED_SOURCE`, `PRODUCT_DEFINITION`, `PRODUCT_DEFINITION_SHAPE`,
72:       `SHAPE_DEFINITION_REPRESENTATION`, `PRODUCT_RELATED_PRODUCT_CATEGORY`) and the
73:       `ADVANCED_BREP_SHAPE_REPRESENTATION` binding `MANIFOLD_SOLID_BREP` to the context.
74: 
75: ## 5. Native writer API (`native_exchange.h`, OCCT-free umbrella)
76: 
77: - [x] 5.1 Entries `step_export_native(solid, path)` (→ bool) + `step_can_export_native`
78:       (→ bool) + `writeStepString(solid)` (→ buffer, for tests). No OCCT / engine types.
79: - [x] 5.2 Confirmed the whole `src/native/exchange/` subtree compiles with
80:       `/opt/homebrew/opt/llvm/bin/clang++ -std=c++20 -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic` with NO
81:       OCCT and NO simulator (clean, no warnings).
82: 
83: ## 6. Engine wiring + OCCT-read round-trip self-check (`src/engine/native/native_engine.cpp`)
84: 
85: - [x] 6.1 `step_export`: if `isNative(body)` and `step_can_export_native`, call
86:       `step_export_native` on the native `topology::Shape`, writing `path`; returns success.
87: - [x] 6.2 Mandatory OCCT-read round-trip self-check (behind `CYBERCAD_HAS_OCCT`): re-read
88:       the written file with `STEPControl_Reader`, require a valid single-solid shape,
89:       compare volume / bbox / sub-shape counts vs the source. Realised at the sim gate
90:       (Gate 2) where OCCT is linked — the host has no OCCT to self-check against; entity
91:       arg orders were also cross-checked against the OCCT `RWStep*` writer modules. GREEN:
92:       native-written → OCCT re-read round-trips to the SAME solid — box vol relV 2.27e-16
93:       / area rel 1.89e-16 / centroidΔ 0 / bbox maxCornerΔ 1.00e-07, faces 6→6 edges 24→24;
94:       cylinder relV 1.27e-03 / area rel 5.97e-04 / bbox 1.00e-07, faces 9→9 edges 30→30;
95:       holed-plate relV 2.90e-04 / area rel 1.09e-04 / bbox 1.00e-07, faces 7→7, edges
96:       28→30 (within tol — sewn periodic-wall seam, matching OCCT's own writer). Writer
97:       parity native-vs-OCCT (both re-read): box/cylinder/holed-plate relV ≤ 4.70e-15,
98:       relA ≤ 6.48e-15, bboxΔ 0.
99: - [x] 6.3 On DECLINE / out-of-scope native body, DISCARD (no file) and return an honest
100:       error (never a faked file, never a native void handed to OCCT); a foreign
101:       (OCCT-built) body falls through to OCCT `STEPControl_Writer`.
102: - [x] 6.4 Return success (`Result<void>{}` → facade `1`) on native success, matching the
103:       `cc_step_export` contract.
104: - [x] 6.5 Left `step_import`, `iges_export`, `iges_import` UNCHANGED (still `fallback().*`,
105:       OCCT).
106: 
107: ## 7. Gate 1 — host structural unit tests (no OCCT)
108: 
109: - [x] 7.1 `tests/native/test_native_step_writer.cpp`: a native box / cylinder emits a
110:       buffer with correct framing (`ISO-10303-21;` … `END-ISO-10303-21;`), an AP203
111:       `FILE_SCHEMA`, a millimetre `SI_UNIT`.
112: - [x] 7.2 Assert exactly one `MANIFOLD_SOLID_BREP` → one `CLOSED_SHELL`; an `ADVANCED_FACE`
113:       per native face with the right surface entity (box → 6 `PLANE`; cylinder →
114:       `CYLINDRICAL_SURFACE` + `PLANE` caps).
115: - [x] 7.3 Assert curve entities (`LINE` / `CIRCLE`) via `EDGE_CURVE` / `ORIENTED_EDGE` /
116:       `EDGE_LOOP` (box → 12 shared `EDGE_CURVE`, 24 `ORIENTED_EDGE`), and `VERTEX_POINT`
117:       (box → 8) / `CARTESIAN_POINT` / `DIRECTION` leaves.
118: - [x] 7.4 Assert every `#n` line is a well-formed contiguous ascending
119:       `#n = ENTITY(...);` (no dangling forward reference) and coordinates are STEP REALs.
120: - [x] 7.5 DECLINE cases → `canSerialize` false: a null shape, a bare vertex (non-solid).
121: - [x] 7.6 Facade case in `tests/test_native_engine.cpp`
122:       (`native_step_export_writes_valid_ap203_file`): native `cc_step_export` returns `1`
123:       for a representable native box and writes a file with the ISO magic +
124:       `MANIFOLD_SOLID_BREP` + mm `SI_UNIT`.
125: - [x] 7.7 Wired into host CTest (`test_native_step_writer`); all existing native suites
126:       green (host CTest 20/20).
127: 
128: ## 8. Gate 2 — sim native-write / OCCT-read round-trip (the correctness gate)
129: 
130: - [x] 8.1 `tests/sim/native_step_parity.mm` + `scripts/run-sim-native-step.sh` through the
131:       `cc_*` facade under `cc_set_engine(1)`: export a native-built solid, re-read the file
132:       with OCCT `STEPControl_Reader`. GREEN — box / cylinder / holed-plate all re-read to a
133:       valid solid.
134: - [x] 8.2 Round-tripped shape matches the source native solid — volume / bbox / sub-shape
135:       counts / topology within tolerance. GREEN — box EXACT (vol 1000, 6 faces, 24 edges);
136:       cylinder vol rel 1.27e-3 / 9 faces; holed-plate vol rel 2.90e-4 / 7 faces; a sewn
137:       periodic wall gains one seam edge the deferred-sharing native source omits (native 28
138:       → re-read 30, matching OCCT's own writer — accepted as a bounded superset). Two writer
139:       bugs fixed to reach this: EDGE_LOOP/ADVANCED_FACE stray `'',''` arg (rejected → empty
140:       solid) and the missing full-turn-wall SEAM edge (read back zero-area → leaky solid);
141:       both pinned by host regression tests.
142: - [x] 8.3 Fall-through cases GREEN — a foreign / OCCT-built solid forwards to
143:       `STEPControl_Writer` (writer-parity native vs OCCT rel ≤ 4.7e-15); an out-of-scope
144:       native solid returns a clean error, never a native void handed to OCCT.
145: - [x] 8.4 `cc_step_import`, `cc_iges_export`, `cc_iges_import` UNCHANGED (still OCCT) under
146:       both engine settings.
147: - [x] 8.5 Own `main()`, on the `run-sim-suite.sh` SKIP list; 221-assertion count unchanged
148:       (`run-sim-suite.sh` re-verified 221/221).
149: 
150: ## 9. Docs + validation
151: 
152: - [x] 9.1 `openspec validate add-native-data-exchange --strict` green.
153: - [x] 9.2 Measured cognitive complexity of `src/native/exchange/` (`cognitive-complexity`
154:       skill): all functions 🟢 Excellent (worst `geometrySupported` 7), NO systems-band
155:       function.
156: - [x] 9.3 Updated `openspec/NATIVE-REWRITE.md` #7 status + `docs/STATUS-phase-4.md`:
157:       STEP export native (Gate 1 green; OCCT round-trip is Gate 2 on the sim); STEP import
158:       + IGES stay OCCT; #8 `drop-occt` stays blocked. Living-spec sync/archive when both
159:       gates are green.
